descriptionChirho: To love with deliberate affection, devotion, or goodwill toward persons or God, encompassing all active-voice finite and infinitival forms of agapao.
Perfect passive participle used as a substantive adjective or form of address meaning 'beloved one' or 'dear one', indicating the enduring state of being loved.
Non-participial passive voice forms indicating the experience of being loved or receiving love from another.
